in_marathi.name: Bhaktavatsala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of devotion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaktavatsala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhaktavatsala refers to the divine goddess who embodies the essence of devotion towards the divine. In Hindu mythology, she is known to offer solace to the distressed, heal emotional wounds, and bestow blessings upon those who seek her grace.
